note: The fuzzer-controlled object bytes are passed as raw data to the type-specific parser; for tag objects this dispatches to git_tag__parse_raw.
The parser receives the input buffer and computes buffer_end solely from the supplied input size.
The valid tagger line is parsed and advances buffer to the following non-empty trailing header bytes in the candidate.
A non-newline byte after the tagger means the code must search for a header/message separator, but it does not limit that search to buffer_end.
strstr treats buffer as a NUL-terminated string and can read past buffer_end while looking for the separator when the remaining input lacks a blank line.
